title: 6 Strange Things Found in the Deep Sea
description:
A golden orb two miles down? Lines of holes nobody can explain? Oxygen made in total darkness? Here are six strange things found in the deep sea, what was actually found, and an honest verdict for each: solved, best guess, or still unknown.

0:00 A golden orb on the seafloor?
0:17 #1 The golden orb
2:05 #2 The holes in the seafloor
3:09 #3 The real kraken
4:10 #4 The milky seas
5:44 #5 Dark oxygen
6:56 #6 The giants of the deep
7:54 Scoreboard

3D scenes are illustrations based on the sources.
